const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip()).resolve(strict=True)
manifest=json.loads(Path('/Users/oubiwann/lab/oxur/nms-copilot/.worktrees/planning/project01-mvp/arc06-fit-and-finish/slice33-query-api-documentation/source-allowlist.json').read_text())
assert root==Path(manifest['source_root']).resolve(strict=True)==Path.cwd().resolve(strict=True)
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--abbrev-ref','HEAD'],text=True).decode().strip()=='codex/query-api-documentation'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==manifest['baseline']
for rel in manifest['paths']: assert (root/rel).resolve(strict=True).is_relative_to(root)
assert set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines())==set(manifest['paths'])
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary'])).hexdigest()=='4dbbb1b6a45ee4388aa446502eda0b0060b93be478783f5a7fd0e4034fc35fa5'
raw=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/nms-slice33-cc-attempts.json').read_text())
labels=['initial-format','initial-lint','iter01-format','iter01-lint','iter02-format','iter02-lint','iter02-tests','iter02-strict-docs','iter02-scope-audit','iter02-diffcheck-working','iter02-diffcheck-baseline']
by_label={x['label']:x for x in raw['attempts']}
assert all(by_label[label]['status']=='complete' and by_label[label]['raw_completion']['exit_code']==0 for label in labels)
parse=next(x for x in raw['attempts'] if x['label']=='precommit-trailer-parse')
assert parse['status']=='complete' and parse['raw_completion']['exit_code']==0
parsed=base64.b64decode(parse['raw_completion']['stdout']['base64']).decode().splitlines()
assert parsed==['Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>','Co-authored-by: Billo AI <ai-engineering@billo.systems>']
assert parse['raw_completion']['stderr']['bytes']==0
message=Path('/private/tmp/nms-slice33-commit-message.txt').read_text()
assert message.count('Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>')==1
assert message.count('Co-authored-by: Billo AI <ai-engineering@billo.systems>')==1
assert message.endswith('Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>\nCo-authored-by: Billo AI <ai-engineering@billo.systems>\n')
print('Commit preflight passed: exact branch/source paths, all 11 proof gates green, pre-commit parser returned both trailers once in order, clean index, no untracked files.')
PY",
  workdir: "/Users/oubiwann/lab/oxur/nms-copilot/.worktrees/query-api-documentation",
  max_output_tokens: 600
});
text(r.output);
